adjudication.rationale: Looking at refreshOAuthTokens.ts, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, it sends only calcomUserId and appSlug to the sync endpoint. The credential table can have multiple credentials per user per app (e.g., multiple Google Calendar accounts). The sync endpoint at app-credential.ts uses findFirst with userId and appId, which would return an arbitrary credential if multiple exist. This means tokens could be persisted to the wrong credential record when a user has multiple accounts for the same app.
